videoTitle: Hail, Caesar! - Official Trailer 2 | 'So Simple' - Coen Brothers Movie

comments.author: @artistpino
comments.text: Best scene in the movie hands down. I don't know where this Alden came from but he is a star. He was so funny and charming throughout the movie. I love Ralph Fiennes in everything but he was hilarious in this. The trailer for this movie seems like it might be more of a crime caper comedy or something.  The trailer is fantastic and the movie is fantastic but I don't necessarily think they match up. This movie is really a love letter by the Coens to the golden age of hollywood. Any fan of old hollywood movies or history will have a great time seeing behind the curtain of big movies and picking up on references to real people and characters of the time. The movie isn't overly complicated and the stakes are the lowest of any Coen brothers movie I've ever seen.  Much like a Taratino movie it is not really plot driven but dialogue and character. If you take it for what it is and just enjoy the feeling of the film it is a really good time.
